title: macOS: canonical TestTempRoot (/private/var) is refused by the Engram control fixture's lexical temp-root guard; 135 new Rust failures on master
outcome: On macOS, master's Rust tests pass again: the only expected failure is the separately tracked production watcher regression (w-2d9eb34a613a). The Engram control fixture's temp-root guard accepts the canonical TestTempRoot that w-10e7c58fba6a introduced, and keeps refusing every home outside the TermAl test temp root.
acceptance: The fixture scripts' --home guard accepts homes under the canonical (symlink-resolved) TermAl test temp root that the Rust side now creates, including /var to /private/var on macOS. It still refuses any home outside that root and any home with a `..` segment, with exit 4 and the existing message. The ps1 fixture stays consistent with the sh fixture.

Every one of the 135 non-watcher Rust failures in Mac run test-9fb9a3f0 (master 43a55125) is attributed, by test name, to a root cause, and each cause in scope is fixed. The fixture-guard refusals, TCP-readiness deadlines, startup EOFs and any lexical-versus-canonical alias assertions are covered.

A standard full gate on a test ref on the Mac shows 0 Rust failures other than the known watcher test, and the standard full gate on Windows stays green. The review pair and the exact-input integration gate are recorded.
